prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: a wide, finished website section background for BinaHub program recommendations; raster artwork only, not a UI mockup.
Primary request: A calm, luminous sculptural study of a single continuous ribbon folding through space, suggesting different needs finding a shared direction. Premium contemporary 3D editorial art with the refined materiality of a product design launch and the soft atmosphere of an airy sky. An opaque pale ice-blue studio backdrop, clean and nearly white at the edges. One ribbon, large flowing form travelling diagonally through the wide frame, mostly on the right two-thirds, with generous quiet pale-blue negative space on the left for a separate HTML content layer.
Color palette: BinaHub deep navy #0B2C6B and gentle cornflower blue, softly translucent milky glass, a restrained warm champagne-gold #D9A441 rim catching the light. Soft pale blue and white light field, no purple or pink.
Materials and lighting: frosted optical glass and smooth satin, subtle transmission, physically convincing soft daylight, delicate shadows, highly controlled reflections, sophisticated not flashy.
Composition: landscape about 3:2, sculpture fully contained with breathing room, no cropped-off hard edges. Intricate light inside one uncomplicated elegant form. Crisp enough to hold up at large desktop size.
Constraints: no words, no typography, no logos, no symbols, no charts, no controls, no people, no decorative stars, no watermarks; no UI or photograph of a screen. The HTML will supply all text and interactions.
